annotations.title: Get a link to connect an account

description: Links the user opens to connect their social accounts, one per network, with what is already connected on each. For each ready network, hand over `directLink` first: it is a single-use link, valid for 15 minutes (see `expiresAt`), that needs no Spica Post sign-in: it opens a short page naming the brand and its owner, and one press of Continue goes to the network’s own sign-in page, so you never see a password (for Bluesky, `directLink` opens a short form for their handle and an app password; its entry says so in `how`). Keep `link` (their account page on that network) as a fallback if `directLink` is absent or expired. Give them the link for each network they use, then call accounts_list to see what arrived. A network that cannot be connected yet answers ready: false and no link; say so instead of sending the user to it. Where there is a guide to opening an account on a network (a Google Business Profile, a Facebook Page, an Instagram professional account), `open` names it: read it with help_get for a user who has no account there yet. Use it for a first connection and for one that needs reconnecting. Changes nothing.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

network.description: One network by its key in capabilities, such as "instagram". Leave it out for every network that can be connected.
